title: The Tortoise and the Two Ducks
logline: When her pond dries up, a tortoise is carried through the sky by two duck friends on a stick she must hold in her mouth; stung by the laughter of villagers below, she opens it to answer and falls.
moral: Keep your word and your temper: one answer given in anger can undo everything your friends have done for you.
tone: Warm and funny for the first two thirds (a slow tortoise, two earnest ducks, a clever plan), real suspense in the air, then a quiet, honest ending without gore or jokes.

beats.summary: A tortoise at home in a full pond.
Her two duck friends arrive, as every morning, with stories of far places.
No rain: the pond shrinks to a puddle.
She is frightened; she cannot travel far.
The ducks know a big lake beyond the hills; but how can she get there?
The one rule: do not open your mouth.
The pebble demonstration: speak and it falls (setup for the climax).
Delight almost makes her speak; she stays silent.
The villagers see her and shout.
She opens her mouth to answer.
She lets go of the stick and falls.
She does not survive; the laughter stops.
The ducks reach the lake alone, with an empty stick.

sets.description: sky + sun + treeRow + hillTrees + ground from the Library, plus a new pond with level 0..1 (water ellipse, wet ring, cracked mud ring, reeds, a flat stone). Palettes: fresh morning (S1) and hot dry (S2 to S6).

Open sky with cloudFlat layers and a scrolling aerialStrip below: tree crowns, then small roofs, then a far patchwork with a river thread. Three parallax layers driven by one flight distance function.
A lane with three flat-roofed mud houses (one window, one doorway, a dome on one roof), a palm and a wall; also drawn small inside aerialStrip. Generic and reusable.
Composed from Library sky (dusk preset), hillTrees and river() widened to fill the lower panel, plus reeds; matches the picture in the S3 thought cloud.

props.description: Brown branch 420 long with two knots and a twig stub; bends as a quadratic curve under load; can float.
Small grey stone for the demonstration.
Tiny snail (spiral shell, two eye stalks) that overtakes the tortoise.
Red ball the child plays with.

scenes.summary: Morning at the full pond. The tortoise wakes, her two duck friends fly in as they do every morning, and their stories of rivers, mountains and far places play in a thought cloud while she listens with shining eyes.

camera.notes: Open on the whole pond at zoom 1.0 (x 500, y 640); ease to zoom 1.35 on the stone and the near water by 5.2 and hold; widen a little to 1.2 at 13.9 so the thought cloud has room above the ducks.

Ducks land on the water at (610, 965) and (760, 985) facing left. treeRow behind, sun top right (800, 190). Thought cloud at (600, 430), about 520 wide, clear of every face.

scenes.summary: Lift-off and flight. The stick bows under her weight, her feet leave the ground one by one, trees and houses sink away. She dares to look down, is amazed, nearly cries out, catches herself and stays silent.

Flight is left to right; the ground strip scrolls right to left below. Keep the rig in the upper 60 % of the panel; her face is never below panel y 800.

scenes.summary: Over a village. Their shadow crosses a child, who looks up; a man shouts LOOK!; the others laugh and crane their necks. In the air the tortoise hears it: her face darkens, she trembles, and a thought cloud shows what she wants to tell them. The ducks, bills full of stick, can only shake their heads.

subtitles.ar: عاشت سلحفاة في بركة جميلة بين الأشجار. | وكان لها صديقتان من البطّ، تزورانها كل صباح. | كانت السلحفاة تحب سماع قصصهما عن الأنهار والجبال والأماكن البعيدة.
subtitles.en: A tortoise lived in a beautiful pond among the trees. | She had two duck friends who visited her every morning. | The tortoise loved hearing their stories of rivers, mountains, and distant places.

subtitles.ar: مرّت أيام طويلة دون مطر، وبدأ ماء البركة ينقص. | جفّ الطين عند أطرافها، ولم يبقَ إلا قليل من الماء. | خافت السلحفاة، لأنها لا تستطيع السفر بعيدًا بسرعة.
subtitles.en: Many days passed without rain, and the pond began to lose water. | The mud around its edges dried, and only a little water remained. | The tortoise was frightened because she could not travel far quickly.

subtitles.ar: قالت إحدى البطتين: «نعرف بحيرة كبيرة خلف التلال، | وفيها ماء كثير.» | سألت السلحفاة: «وكيف أصل إليها؟ | أنتما تستطيعان الطيران، أما أنا فأمشي ببطء شديد.»
subtitles.en: One duck said, “We know a large lake beyond the hills, | and it has plenty of water.” | The tortoise asked, “But how can I get there? | You can fly, while I walk very slowly.”

subtitles.ar: فكّرت البطتان قليلًا، ثم وجدتا عصًا قوية. | قالتا: «سنمسك طرفَي العصا بمنقارينا، | وأنتِ أمسكي وسطها بفمك. | هكذا نحملك معنا في الهواء، حتى نصل إلى البحيرة.»
subtitles.en: The ducks thought for a moment, then found a strong stick. | “We will hold the two ends with our beaks,” they said, | “and you hold the middle in your mouth. | Then we can carry you through the air to the lake.”

subtitles.ar: فرحت السلحفاة كثيرًا، لكن البطتين قالتا لها: «هناك أمر مهم جدًا. | لا تفتحي فمك أثناء الطيران، مهما سمعتِ من كلام. | إذا تكلمتِ، ستسقطين!» | هزّت السلحفاة رأسها موافقة.
subtitles.en: The tortoise was delighted, but the ducks warned her, “There is one very important thing. | Do not open your mouth while we are flying, no matter what you hear. | If you speak, you will fall!” | The tortoise nodded.

subtitles.ar: أمسكت السلحفاة العصا بفمها، ورفعت البطتان جناحيهما. | ارتفعت البطتان والسلحفاة فوق الأشجار والبيوت. | نظرت السلحفاة إلى الأرض البعيدة، وشعرت بالدهشة والفرح، | لكنها بقيت صامتة.
subtitles.en: The tortoise gripped the stick in her mouth, and the ducks spread their wings. | The ducks and tortoise rose above the trees and houses. | The tortoise looked down at the distant ground, amazed and happy, | but she stayed silent.

subtitles.ar: مرّت فوق قرية، فرآها بعض الناس. | صاح أحدهم: «انظروا! سلحفاة تطير بين بطتين!» | وضحك الآخرون ورفعوا رؤوسهم. | غضبت السلحفاة، وأرادت أن تقول لهم إنها ليست طائرًا غريبًا.
subtitles.en: They passed above a village, and some people saw them. | “Look!” someone shouted. “A tortoise is flying between two ducks!” | Others laughed and looked up. | The tortoise grew angry and wanted to tell them she was not some strange bird.

subtitles.ar: نسيت السلحفاة تحذير صديقتيها، وفتحت فمها لتردّ على الناس. | في اللحظة نفسها، تركت العصا وسقطت إلى الأرض. | لم تنجُ السلحفاة من السقوط، | ووصلت البطتان إلى البحيرة وحدهما.
subtitles.en: The tortoise forgot her friends’ warning and opened her mouth to answer the people. | At that very moment, she let go of the stick and fell to the ground. | The tortoise did not survive the fall, | and the two ducks reached the lake alone.

ending.description: The two ducks on the wide dusk lake with the stick floating between them, both looking at its empty middle. THE END pops in the sky at 170.6 and is held, with a slow pull-out, to 174.45. No moral caption: the script does not speak one.

new_assets.name: duck
new_assets.description: A duck with two palettes (white, mallard). Pose fields: fly, flap, ph/amp (waddle), swim, neck (bend down 0..1), headRot, talk, bill (open), clamp, wing (gesture angle), wingsUp, plus the shared acting fields.
new_assets.implementation: Start from Library bird(): larger oval body (K.shape ellipse with dot shading), a two-segment neck (quadratic stroke) ending in a round head, a flat two-part bill, webbed triangle feet. Wings reuse the bird flap geometry scaled 1.5. Wrap with acting() and add a registry entry and catalogue poses.

new_assets.name: tortoise acting head, bite and dangle
new_assets.description: Optional fields on the Library tortoise so she can carry a film: neck (extension), headRot, talk, mouth set, brow, bite (jaw clamped on a bar), dangle (legs hang and swing), front foot raise.
new_assets.implementation: Add the fields with defaults that reproduce the current drawing exactly (regression must stay identical). Head is drawn at the end of a neck stroke whose length and angle come from neck/headRot; mouth and brow copied from the turtle figure. When dangle is set the four legs are drawn as short capsules rotated by swing().

new_assets.name: flush
new_assets.description: Anger flush 0..1: red Ben-Day dots climbing the face from the neck, with optional steam puffs.
new_assets.implementation: Clip to the head shape and fill the style red dot pattern up to a height set by flush; puffs are K.popIn circles on short kfn paths.

new_assets.name: carryRig
new_assets.description: Two carriers hold a bar and a rider hangs from its middle: bar ends follow the carriers, the bar bends with the load, the rider swings from the midpoint and can let go.
new_assets.implementation: A pure function rig(t) returning both duck poses, the stick curve and the rider pose. Duck y = flight path + flap bob (phases a third of a cycle apart); stick = quadratic through the two bill tips with sag proportional to load (load goes 1 to 0 at the release, with rebound()); rider hangs from the midpoint with swing(); after release rider y = fallY. Uses the planned bird carry idea for the bill grip.

new_assets.name: pond
new_assets.description: A pond with a level parameter for stories about water and drought.
new_assets.implementation: pond(c, {x, y, w, level, cracks, t}): outer dry ring (tan), darker wet ring, water ellipse scaled by level with blue dots and ripple(); cracks are seeded polylines (K.rng) revealed by the cracks value; reeds are strokes on swing().

new_assets.name: village
new_assets.description: Small village lane with flat-roofed houses, window, doorway, dome and palm.
new_assets.implementation: Rectangles with brush outlines and dot shading, baked once with bake(); the same function at scale 0.25 gives the roofs for aerialStrip.

new_assets.name: aerialStrip
new_assets.description: Scrolling ground seen from the air in three parallax layers (crowns, roofs, far patchwork).
new_assets.implementation: Three baked strips 3000 wide drawn at offsets -dist(t) * [1, 0.6, 0.25]; hillTrees crowns, village at small scale, flat colour fields with a wobbly river line.

new_assets.name: villager
new_assets.description: Reuses the planned villager / villageWoman person variants (KD-005) with a child size.
new_assets.implementation: Person figure with costume parameters (headwear, tunic colour, beard, scale); the child is scale 0.7 with a larger head ratio.

new_assets.name: thoughtCloud
new_assets.description: Reuses the planned generic thought cloud (stories, the lake promise, the plan board, the angry wish).
new_assets.implementation: cloud outline with trailing bubbles to the thinker; clip and draw a callback inside at its own scale.

new_assets.name: groundShadow
new_assets.description: The moving shadow of flying characters on ground and walls.
new_assets.implementation: Dark ellipses at 25 % alpha at the rig x, drawn on the lane and clipped to the house fronts.

new_assets.name: stick, pebble, snail, ball
new_assets.implementation: Each one K.shape or stroke function with a header comment; the stick takes a bend value and two end points.

implementation_notes: Cue every beat from timing.json word starts (w(p, n)); the cue times in this plan are those starts. Long words (60.06, 109.98, 148.66, 162.58) probably begin with silence: start the action up to 0.4 s later if the audio shows it.
Build rig(t) first (carryRig) and test it with stills at 109.98, 112.7, 122.5, 154.3, 157.9 and 161.2 before staging anything else; scenes S6 to S9 all depend on it.
Ducks hold the stick from above: both face right, necks bent down, bills clamped over the stick. This avoids a duck having to hold a stick behind its head and reads clearly at phone size.
The ducks never move in unison: offset flap phase by a third of a cycle, reactions by 4 to 6 frames, and give duck B the bigger, later reaction throughout.
Set LIFE.t = t for automatic blinks; suppress blinks (noBlink) during the frightened hold at 33.8, the realisation at 157 to 159 and the villagers freeze at 162.6.
The pebble drop at 96.42 and the tortoise release at 154.26 must share the same picture: an open mouth, a clear gap, a short hang, then fallY. Keep both on the panel centre line.
Death is shown by absence: she falls behind the roof line; never draw an impact or a body. Use only a dust column and the reactions.
Keep the caption panel still: apply shake inside the picture panel only. Balloons and labels must stay clear of faces and inside the picture panel.
Tortoise scale: about 1.9 on the ground and in the rig so her face is at least 90 px wide on screen; close-ups go to zoom 2.2 or more.
Sound: only the listed effects, in the listed pauses, with SND master 0.6. There is no effect on the fall or the impact (no pause there, and silence is stronger).
Call S.finish last every frame; one transition card only (19.4).
warnings: New drawing load is above the usual four major assets (duck, tortoise acting fields, pond, village, aerialStrip, carryRig). The village and the villagers can be shared with KD-005; if time is short, drop the two extra onlookers and the ball.

The Library tortoise is small and simple; if extending it without changing its default look is awkward, build the heroine on the turtle head (talk, brow, mouth already exist) with the tortoise shell and legs, as a new optional variant.
The ending is a death in a children fable. It is staged off screen. Confirm that this restraint is what the series wants, and that no spoken or written moral should be added.
No pause exists around the fall (160.8 to 162.6) so no impact sound is planned; if a real silence is measured inside the long word at 162.58, a very soft thud could be considered.
The balloon I AM NOT A is invented lettering standing for the narrated intention to answer the people; remove it if only true sound words are wanted.
